doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Singers she likes today
summary: She admires John Legend, Beyonce and Christina Aguilera.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: But you are a fan of John Legend? No?

I’m not just a fan. I’m – I got a crush on John Legend. I have a crush on Ludacris. Oh yeah. He is fine. I saw him at the – I don’t know what it is – the Oscars or the Grammys, and he came out there in a tuxedo that just blew me away. He looked so good. I like Ludacris. I like – I’m crazy about John Legend. I love his sound, his tonal quality. There’s a resonance in there that just gets to me. I like Seal. I can’t talk about Lady Gaga and people like that, because that’s like – has nothing to do with – who can sing is Beyoncé. She can sing. Not just the showgirl. I mean, when she sang Listen in
Dreamgirls – I saw her do it in person – she is – she has a magnificent voice, and it doesn’t have to be all of the today’s stuff. She’s got a long life of music ahead of her.

She has a brilliant voice. She’s got a great voice. Don’t know any of her stuff. I’ve heard her voice, yes. I think she’s excellent. Who else is there? I can’t think of anybody in the jazz field’s name. That’s what disturbs me. That really does.
